vectors.name: escapes
vectors.about: An action needing every escape SPEC section 4 pins, exactly as RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.2 spells them: \" and \\, the short forms \b \t \n \f \r, lowercase \u00xx for the other controls, and DEL, NEL, U+2028 and U+2029 as they stand.
vectors.last_line: VALID

vectors.name: escapes-other-spelling

vectors.last_line: VALID

vectors.name: escapes-hashed-wrong
vectors.about: The same entry hashed over a canonical form that spells its controls as uppercase \u hex and escapes DEL, NEL and the separators: what a verifier with other escaping would compute. It does not hold.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 1: entry_hash does not match canonical form

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-text

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-json

vectors.name: unsupported-version-new-fields

vectors.name: package-unsealed
vectors.about: One chain and the project record, listed by a manifest declaring no seal: the ceiling, with its limit.

vectors.name: package-artifact-altered
vectors.about: The same package with project.json rewritten after the manifest listed it: its sha256 is not the listed one.
vectors.last_line: ARTIFACT-DIVERGED: something in this package is not what the manifest lists (the lines above say what)

vectors.name: package-named-twice
vectors.about: A zip of the unsealed package with a second member of the chain's name ahead of it, entry 2 edited: which one is read depends on the unzip, so it is refused unopened.
vectors.last_line: UNSUPPORTED-FORMAT: package-named-twice.zip holds two members that unpack to one file, 'receipts-vector.jsonl' twice; which one is read depends on the tool that unpacks it, so this verifier refuses it unopened

vectors.name: package-seal-missing
vectors.about: The manifest declares an anchor and no manifest.json.anchors.jsonl is in the package: a stripped seal fails, never reads as unsealed.
vectors.last_line: SEAL-MISSING: a seal the manifest declares is not in this package (the seal line above says which)

vectors.name: package-unknown-format
vectors.about: The manifest's format is a tag this verifier does not speak: a refusal, and nothing is judged.
vectors.last_line: UNSUPPORTED-FORMAT: package is format "loxodonta-package/2"; this verifier speaks "loxodonta-package/1"

vectors.name: package-anchored

vectors.name: package-anchored-unchecked
vectors.about: The same package with no header given: the rung is earned, and the block is the attestation's claim.
